# LostStreet

> LostStreet is a 100% free world detective and street view geography guessing game.
> Players explore 360-degree panoramas across 195+ nations and use meta clues (camera generations, bollards, utility poles, road markings, sun direction) to deduce their exact location.

## Core URLs
- [Homepage & Free Play](https://www.loststreet.online): Play unlimited geography guessing rounds with no sign-up or paid subscription.
- [Flag Guesser](https://www.loststreet.online/flag-guesser): Identify country flags in Easy (4 choices), Medium (alternating map pinning), and Hard (pure map pinning) modes.
- [Global Leaderboard](https://www.loststreet.online/leaderboard): Real-time ELO rankings and player performance stats.
- [Guides & Strategy](https://www.loststreet.online/guides): Complete masterclass library for street view and world detective meta clues.

## Masterclass Guides & Meta Clues
- [25 Pro Street View & GeoGuessr Secrets Most Players Don](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/25-pro-street-view-geoguessr-secrets): Discover 25 pro secrets and meta clues used by top GeoGuessr players: Kenya Snorkel, Ghana Tape, Sky Rifts, French Holey Poles & more.
- [How to Identify African Countries in Street View (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/africa-street-view-guide): Master African countries in street view games. Region-by-region breakdown of visual clues for West, East, Southern & North Africa — road signs, vegetation, languages & more.
- [How to Identify Asian Countries in Street View (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/asia-street-view-guide): Identify Asian countries from street view clues. Covers East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia & Central Asia — scripts, bollards, architecture & driving side tips.
- [Best Free GeoGuessr Alternatives & Street View Guessers (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/best-free-geoguessr-alternatives): Discover the top free GeoGuessr alternatives and free street view guesser games in 2026. Explore LostStreet for unlimited 360° panoramas, 1v1 duels, and zero subscriptions.
- [How to Identify European Countries in Street View (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/europe-street-view-guide): Tell European countries apart in geography games. Country-specific road signs, bollards, license plates & architecture for Western, Eastern, Nordic & Southern Europe.
- [World Flag Identification Guide (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/flag-identification-guide): Learn to identify every country flag by color, pattern & region. Tricolours, crescents, crosses, stars — plus the most commonly confused flag pairs in quiz games.
- [Ultimate Street View Clues Cheat Sheet (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/geography-clues-guide): The complete reference to every visual clue in Google Street View. Bollards, road markings, utility poles, sun position, driving side & vegetation — master them all.
- [The 10 Hardest Countries to Guess in Street View (2026 Clues)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/hardest-countries-to-guess): Struggling with Russia, Lesotho, or Argentina? Master the exact visual clues, road markings, and car meta to identify the 10 hardest countries instantly.
- [The Map Sleuth](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/how-to-guess-locations-from-street-view): Drop into any random street view location and guess the country in under a minute using road sign hardware, bollards, utility poles, and language toponymy clues.
- [How to Get Better at Geography Guessing Games (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/how-to-improve-at-geography-games): Practical strategies to improve your geography game scores. Learn languages, road signs, infrastructure, climate and more — used by top GeoGuessr & LostStreet players.
- [How to Identify Latin American Countries in Street View (2026 Guide)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/latin-america-street-view-guide): Master Latin American geography clues in Street View. Discover road sign cross backings, yellow license plates, utility pole styles, and vegetation hints.
- [Multiplayer Geography Game Tips & 1v1 Duel Strategy (2026)](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/multiplayer-geography-tips): Win more 1v1 duels & multiplayer geography matches. Time management, risk strategy, reading opponent guesses & clutch tips for GeoGuessr & LostStreet.
- [Google Street View Camera Generations (Gen 1–Gen 4) Complete Guide](https://www.loststreet.online/guides/street-view-camera-generations-guide): Master Street View camera generations. Learn to identify Gen 1 blur, Gen 2 purple halos, Gen 3 clarity, and Gen 4 wide-angle lenses to pinpoint countries instantly.
